title: Record V45 widths and the inherited call order
body:
## Summary
- Both providers charge helpers 249, 251, 265 and 267 at width 8 in the parent and width 7 in the shipped words. Those four are part of six width-8 drops; the other two are helpers 299 and 331.
- The idle histogram recomputed from the stored basis patterns matches the certificates. It moves at stage 1 and is the same from stage 2 through the final certificate. That histogram is the joint inventory.
- The shipped ORDER and DISPATCH files are byte-identical to `research/paired-helper-extension` and differ from this package's baseline order. There are 666 calls. No new exponent.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/rank7-v45-idle-chronology/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/rank7-v45-idle-chronology/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-v45-idle-chronology`
- [ ] Confirm the registered replay on the maintainer's Python 3.12 checkout
